profile_scope: Corrected copying implementation f04d09054, 4 workers, same frozen workload; process CPU includes instrumentation. LD_PRELOAD pthread_create wrapper clocks only worker entry to return, excluding pthread startup/teardown outside the wrapper. All 1,528 worker completions recorded.
one_worker_control_scope: Same compiler/stdlib/input hashes as fixed/ 0 and 4 controls, perf task-event tracing, no native threads or worker transfer. Batch prepare/replay and collection remain enabled.
scope_correction: parallelMap runs incremental function/type/method discovery only. partitionFunctions/FunSpecializer::run remain serial and are excluded by --stop-after-specialization.
observations: Worker execution accounts for about 1.1% of process CPU. Most of the observed slowdown remains with a single worker and no worker-to-main transfer.
Copying also happens at the per-batch withRegion boundary, including prepared IR/context changes. Deferring batch collection tests a different cost from the immediate worker-to-main transfer.

The profile shows key/string comparisons, directory hashing, allocation, sorting and copying/persistence as major costs. Frame-pointer call chains are incomplete; this sampling profile does not isolate exact per-phase wall times.
